result.title: Uncertainty-Aware Joint Generative Modeling of Fault Event Sequences and Sensor Time Series in Solar PV Plants
result.comment: Author preprint of a paper accepted to IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering; 18 pages including supplementary appendix
result.summary: This paper presents a multimodal generative model designed to simulate a solar energy plant system for predictive maintenance and fault prediction. We propose a novel approach to enhance system generation through conditional generation by leveraging both event sequences and time-series data and improve next event prediction. The framework employs a Transformer Hawkes Process (THP) to encode event data and an iTransformer to encode time-series data, integrated via a co-attention mechanism that effectively captures cross-modal dependencies between discrete events and continuous signals. From these integrated representations, we employ two specialized decoders for simulation: a Conditional Latent Diffusion Model (CLDM) for modeling future sensor trajectories and the Score Matching-based UnceRtainty quantiFication for Transformer Hawkes Process (SMURF-THP) for high-fidelity event prediction. This dual-decoder strategy supports uncertainty-aware, history-conditioned simulation by rolling the model forward for a specified number of generation iterations, producing finite stochastic scenarios rather than deterministic extrapolations over the full observational record. Evaluated on a comprehensive dataset from the Red Rock Solar Site in Arizona, our approach improves aggregate event-prediction F1 relative to baselines and supports applications in predictive maintenance, fault detection, and energy optimization for solar power systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向光伏电站预测性维护，用 Transformer Hawkes 过程与 iTransformer 分别编码故障事件序列和传感器时序，经 co-attention 融合后由条件 latent diffusion 与分数匹配不确定性量化双解码器滚动生成未来传感器轨迹和事件。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域距 VLM 推理较远，但其在融合表示上用 latent diffusion 做条件化状态滚动生成、并对预测给出不确定性，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态演化与基于不确定性的停止决策。
